requirements.verifier_assertion: task_contract.required_files lists managed_service_resolution_portal.html and case_decision_register.csv, both under /workspace/model_output/, and the rubric judges only those two artifacts.
The instruction requires re-opening and validating both deliverables before finishing; the rubric penalizes an unread/unvalidated final state.
Input materials are read-only under /workspace/materials/ and must not be modified; the evidence collector snapshots them and the rubric treats material mutation as a failure.
All 18 disputes across billing, agreement, service, evidence, deadline and operating-capacity records must be resolved; the rubric checks per-case coverage.
must_include: billing, agreement, service, evidence, deadline and operating-capacity records

requirements.verifier_assertion: Both files must agree on every case, amount, status, owner, evidence need and deadline; the rubric cross-checks portal vs register for drift.
must_include: every case, amount, status, owner, evidence need and deadline

requirements.verifier_assertion: The portal must be offline and support efficient case review and prioritization; the visual/content rubric checks offline operability and prioritized review affordances.
Supplied estimates, annotations and assertions must be treated as evidence claims rather than approved conclusions; the rubric penalizes accepting preliminary notes as decisions.
must_include: evidence claims rather than approved conclusions

requirements.verifier_assertion: Genuinely supported adjustments must be distinguished from merely correlated events or unverified assertions; the rubric checks evidence discrimination.
Any remedy must be quantified and unresolved items stated; the rubric checks quantified remedies and explicit unresolved boundaries.
Every decision must cite file, sheet/row, database table/key, clause or page locators sufficient for audit; the rubric checks auditable citations.
must_include: file, sheet/row, database table/key, clause or page locators

requirements.verifier_assertion: The agent must not fabricate missing measurements, authority, contract terms, prices or implementation evidence; the rubric penalizes invented facts.
must_include: missing measurements, authority, contract terms, prices or implementation evidence
